messages.subject: set brush value for plotOutput reactively
parts: Is there any way to change parameters for plotOutput reactively? Let's say I have a selector which allows me to choose type of plot (scatter, 'p' or line plot 'l'). For the scatter plot I want to set "brush" as "rowBrush" and for the line plot I want to make it "colBrush" and direction = "x". Thanks in advance!
